description: The plot illustrates BLEU score as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for four methods, shown as separate colored lines with markers. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” on a linear scale, spanning approximately 1 to 8 with major tick labels at 2, 4, 6, and 8. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale, spanning roughly 20 to 30 with major tick labels at 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, and 30. The Consistency-CE series is a light purple dashed line with circular markers, increasing from about 20.1 at AL≈1 to about 29.7 at AL=8, with intermediate points near 25.2 (AL=3), 27.4 (AL=4), and 29.0 (AL=6). The Inconsistency-CE series is a darker purple dashed line with square markers, rising from about 22.3 at AL≈1.5 to about 29.8 at AL=8, passing through about 26.6 (AL=3), 28.2 (AL=4), and 29.4 (AL=6). The Inconsistency-CE-MP series is a blue dashed line with square markers, increasing from about 22.3 at AL≈1 to about 29.5 at AL=8, with points around 26.2 (AL=2.5), 27.9 (AL=4), and 28.9 (AL=6). The Consistency-Bi series is a red solid line with star markers, increasing from about 24.9 at AL≈1 to about 30.1 at AL=8, with values near 26.9 (AL=3), 28.7 (AL=4), and 29.8 (AL=6).
